canonical_incident_record.title: System stopped at bag-out after sorting at UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH)
canonical_incident_record.incident_description: A production-impacting malfunction was opened for UPS Haslet TX (TXRTH) after the system stopped at bag-out after sorting. Case and chat evidence indicate the site manually bagged out while support investigated AGV/robot sequencing or task-related issues. Supporting evidence includes reports that an AGV had not moved for 3 hours, that bag-out started and then stopped again, and that an HMI associated with the hospital area showed a fault. The source also notes this had occurred before according to the customer.
canonical_incident_record.customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The site reported the system would not complete bag-out after sorting, required manual bagging out, and needed AGVs moving for the next sort.
canonical_incident_record.what_resolved_it: Support guidance focused on restoring proper AGV/robot sequence. Case resolution notes state that when AGVs/robots were back in proper sequence, the customer confirmed they were functional and the call ended. Additional evidence shows robots were turned off due to low batteries, later turned back on, and remained on, but the exact decisive recovery step is not fully isolated in the source.
symptoms: System stopped at bag-out after sorting.
Manual bagging out was required during the incident.
One AGV was reported as not moving for 3 hours.
Site reported suspected robot or AGV sequence/task issues.
An HMI at the hospital was reported as showing a fault.
